## dsh-geo-seo (README.md)

dsh-geo-seo is a DSH plugin and CLI that measures whether AI engines can read and cite a repository's documentation, then generates the machine-readable files those engines actually read. It is a measurement tool. It scores documentation against a fixed, versioned rule pack, shows every deduction with a file and line anchor, and states the evidence behind each rule. It does not promise rankings, traffic or citations, and it never estimates them. A score is a description of your documentation, not a forecast. Current version 0.1.0 · requires Node 22.6+ and DSH 0.30+ · MIT · Last updated: 2026-02-18 · 中文简介见 docs/INTRO.md. This repository is a local plugin bundle (dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client), not a published npm package. Build it once: In the desktop app open Plugins → Add plugin and pick this folder (…/geo-seo). The plugin is linked, not copied, so rebuilding picks up changes. Open the right sidebar; the GEO / SEO tab appears in the guide and in the tab menu. The plugin registers five agent tools — geo_seo_check, geo_seo_generate, geo_seo_audit, geo_seo_monitor, geo_seo_questions — and serves its panel from the same local web server as the app (/geo-seo/api/*). Nothing is uploaded anywhere. After npm link (or pnpm add -g .) the same commands are available as geo-seo. Capability What you get Parse Markdown (headings, lists, code, tables, links), package.json, and TS/JS source exports, tools, commands and config keys — every fact keeps a file and line anchor Score 0–100 across seven weighted dimensions, per-dimension deductions, a rewrite suggestion per finding, and the evidence level behind each rule Generate llms.txt, llms-full.txt, ai.txt and JSON-LD from one parse, with a consistency check that refuses to write facts the visible text cannot back Audit Crawlability for international and domestic AI engines: robots rules, sitemaps, meta robots, canonical, JS-only content, Chinese indexing configuration Monitor A 24-question bank, per-run recordings, mention and citation rates, and a trend that says "not statistically meaningful" when the sample is too small Command Purpose check Parse, score and print the report. Writes a history entry unless no-history. generate Render llms.txt, llms-full.txt, ai.txt, structured-data.jsonld. Dry run by default output location: the system temp directory. audit Crawlability findings for international and domestic engines, plus the standing notes. monitor questions prints the bank; answers platform records a sample; bare prints the summary and trend. rules Prints the rule pack (name, version, release date) and every rule's rationale. Flags: dir (defaults to the last scanned directory, then the working directory), format text|json|markdown, strict, fail-under , out , force, dry-run, max-entries , max-findings , no-history, no-color, quiet. Exit codes are stable for CI: 0 ok, 1 threshold or strict failure, 2 usage error, 3 internal error. The weights are fixed by the product requirements and are not configurable: Dimension Points What it measures Topic relevance and intent match 28 The page answers "what is this plugin" in the first screen, under one entity Key-information structure and position 22 Conclusion first, scannable lists, important entries early Fact density and verifiability 18 Install command, version, config keys, examples, cited numbers Time freshness 10 A stated update date that agrees with the commit history Machine-readable structure 12 Continuous headings, matching JSON-LD, llms.txt Trust signals 7 Maintainer, license, feedback channel, release history Consistency and compliance 3 No unverifiable promises, no contradiction, no unlabelled machine text Two rules go beyond simple subtraction: A severe compliance hit (a promise of rankings, traffic or citation outcomes) caps the total at 60, whatever the rest of the page scores. A document far below a useful length loses relevance in proportion to the gap, so a stub cannot collect points for being short. The same suggestion hit in several files is deducted once, and every finding carries the line it came from. File Contents llms.txt Site summary plus 10–20 core pages, with a provenance comment (engine and rule-pack version, timestamp, source files) llms-full.txt The same selection with page bodies inlined, under a size budget ai.txt The llms.txt content under the alternate filename convention structured-data.jsonld JSON-LD restricted to SoftwareApplication, TechArticle or FAQPage, and only for facts the visible text states JSON-LD is verified field by field against the parsed page text before it is written. A claim the body does not support (a rating, an offer, a version that appears nowhere) is dropped or blocks the write, and the generator reports which field failed and why. Ratings and prices are never invented. Existing files are compared, not clobbered: without force a differing file is skipped and reported. For this repository that block looks like: Everything runs locally. The default is zero network access: there is no telemetry, no model call, no upload, and no external fetch. History and monitoring records are written to ~/.dsh/geo-seo/workspaces/ / — override the root with DSH_GEO_SEO_HOME. Delete that folder and the state is gone. It cannot promise or predict rankings, traffic or citations, and it will not print an "expected improvement" percentage. Allowing AI crawlers in robots.txt does not mean they cite you, and this tool says so in every audit. Domestic (Chinese) engine checks read configuration only. There is no public API that confirms indexing, so the tool never claims an index status. Monitoring is manual sampling: a person asks the fixed questions on each platform and records the answers. Rates from fewer than 20 samples are labelled as not statistically meaningful. A high score is not permission to over-optimise. The same PRD that defines the weights records that aggressive optimisation can lower perceived quality; the tool reports what it measured and nothing more. Layout: src/core is the kernel (parse → rules → score → generate → audit → monitor → render → store) and is exported as dsh-geo-seo/core; src/cli and src/index.ts are thin adapters over it; client/index.js is the sidebar tab and assets/panel.html the page it renders. docs/DETAIL.md documents the internals, docs/DETAIL.zh.md is the Chinese version, and docs/INTRO.md holds the short descriptions used for listings. Rules live in src/core/rules.ts with RULE_PACK_VERSION (2026.02.1) and each rule's evidence level; adding a rule means adding one entry plus a fixture in test/. Per-release notes live in CHANGELOG.md; the current release is 0.1.0 (2026-02-18). MIT. Example: 97 / 100 excellent Topic relevance and intent match ████████████ 28/28 Key-information structure and position ████████████ 22/22 Fact density and verifiability ████████████ 18/18 Time freshness ████████████ 10/10 Machine-readable structure █████████░░░ 9/12 Trust signals ████████████ 7/7 Consistency and compliance ████████████ 3/3 INFO MAC-003 -3 llms.txt not found fix: Generate llms.txt plus ai.txt from the parsed facts. at package.json evidence: weak

## sample-plugin (examples/sample-plugin/README.md)

sample-plugin is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that adds a deterministic word counter to the composer. It answers "how long is this note" without sending anything to a server, and it never truncates an answer to make the number look nicer: input that is too long is rejected so that a wrong count cannot be reported as a real one. Version: 1.2.3 (released 2026-02-10) License: MIT Maintainer: Example Maintainers Issues and feedback: https://github.com/example/sample-plugin/issues Package: https://example.com/sample-plugin sample-plugin exposes one tool, count_words, and one command, sample.count. The tool returns the number of words and characters in the text it receives, plus the unit it used for CJK input. The command prints the same numbers into the transcript, so a note can be measured without leaving the conversation. The counter is deterministic: the same input always produces the same numbers, both values are computed locally, and nothing about the text leaves the machine. There is no model call, no network request, and no stored copy of the text. Then add the plugin to your profile. In the desktop app, open Plugins, choose Add plugin, and point it at this folder. For a manual profile, add the package name to the profile and start DeepSeek Harness again. Ask the assistant to count words, or run the command directly: The tool returns JSON that a person and a script can both read: unit is latin when the text counted by whitespace boundaries, and cjk when each Han character was counted as one word. Key Type Default Meaning maxChars number 20000 Inputs longer than this are rejected includeCjk boolean true Count Chinese characters as words stripMarkdown boolean false Ignore Markdown syntax before counting Set the keys in the plugin configuration block: The plugin rejects inputs over maxChars instead of truncating them, because a truncated count would be wrong and silently wrong numbers are worse than an error. The limit is documented, reported in the error payload, and stable across versions, so a caller can split a long document and retry without guessing. The same reasoning applies to CJK counting. Counting by whitespace undercounts Chinese text badly, so the plugin decides the unit from the content and reports which unit it used. A caller that needs one unit everywhere can set includeCjk to false. When the input exceeds maxChars the tool returns an error object with code TOO_LONG and the configured limit. Nothing is written to disk and no partial result is returned. When the input is empty the tool returns zeroes rather than an error, because an empty note has a length of zero and that is a correct answer. The plugin keeps no history, writes no files, and makes no network requests. It reads the configuration once at start-up and holds it in memory for the life of the process. Since the counter is pure, the plugin can be removed at any time without leaving data behind. Node.js 22 or newer is required, because the plugin uses the built-in test runner and the modern module resolution rules. DeepSeek Harness 0.30 or newer is required for the ctx.tools.register and ctx.command APIs this plugin calls. Older hosts will load the plugin and skip its registrations rather than fail. Open an issue at https://github.com/example/sample-plugin/issues for bug reports and feature requests. Please include the version reported by plugin version, the input length, and whether CJK counting was enabled. Security reports should go to the same tracker with the "security" label rather than a public discussion. See CHANGELOG.md for the dated history. The short version: 1.2.3 rejects oversized input instead of truncating it, and 1.2.0 added the includeCjk option. MIT. Copyright (c) 2026 Example Maintainers. Last updated: 2026-02-10 Example: pnpm add dsh-sample-plugin

## dsh-geo-seo — implementation detail (docs/DETAIL.md)

This page documents how the checker works inside: the data flow, the modules, the exact scoring arithmetic, the generation contract, and the places where the implementation deliberately refuses to do something. It is the "detail" document the plugin manifest points at. Local and offline by default. No network call exists in the kernel. The CLI and the panel never fetch anything; monitoring is manual sampling. Facts carry anchors. Every statement the tool makes about a repository is either read from a file (with a path and usually a line) or computed from such values. A rule that cannot point at a line does not ship. The rule pack is versioned and separate from the engine. RULE_PACK_VERSION is reported in every output, file header and report, so a score can be reproduced. Never invent facts. The generator may only restate what the parsed text contains; JSON-LD verification enforces this mechanically. No promise of outcome. No ranking, traffic or citation forecast appears anywhere in the output, including the panel and the generated files. Dependencies point one way: renderers and adapters depend on the kernel, never the other way round. src/core/index.ts is the only public surface (dsh-geo-seo/core). Scan limits: 60 Markdown documents, 200 source files, depth 8, 4000 entries, 4 MiB per file. Ignored directories: .git, node_modules, dist, build, out, coverage, .next, .cache, .turbo, vendor, .venv, pycache, .idea, .vscode, tmp, .geo-seo. Test and example directories are excluded from the source scan so fixtures do not inflate the score. Markdown parsing is a line scanner, not a CommonMark engine: ATX and setext headings, fenced and 4-space-indented code, tables with a divider row, lists with continuation lines, inline links and bare URLs, and YAML front matter. It is deliberately tolerant — an unterminated fence, a malformed table or CRLF endings all parse without throwing. Source inspection is lexical (regular expressions over the file), not a TypeScript program. That keeps the kernel dependency-free and fast; the cost is that highly generated registration code is not understood, which is why a missed tool registration lowers the machine-readable score by at most 4 points instead of being an error. RULE_PACK = { name: 'geo-seo-core', version: '2026.02.1', released: '2026-02-18', scoringVersion: 1 }. Each rule declares a dimension, severity, deduction, an evidence level (strong | moderate | weak | heuristic) and a one-line rationale. Dimension Rules Relevance (28) REL-001 no README · REL-002 no H1 · REL-003 lead paragraph says nothing · REL-004 title and body disagree · REL-005 keyword stuffing · REL-100 too short (proportional) Structure (22) STR-001 heading level skip · STR-002 no section structure · STR-003 answer buried · STR-004 features are prose · STR-005 multiple H1 · STR-006 no table of contents on a long page Facts (18) FAC-001 no install command · FAC-002 version not stated · FAC-003 config undocumented · FAC-004 no runnable example · FAC-005 no repository/issue link · FAC-006 unsourced numbers Freshness (10) FRE-001 no update date · FRE-002 date stale (>365 d) · FRE-003 date disagrees with git (>90 d drift) · FRE-004 no changelog Machine (12) MAC-001 no JSON-LD · MAC-002 invalid/untyped JSON-LD · MAC-003 no llms.txt · MAC-004 llms.txt too thin · MAC-005 AI crawlers blocked Trust (7) TRU-001 no license · TRU-002 no maintainer · TRU-003 no feedback channel · TRU-004 no release history Compliance (3) COM-001 unverifiable promise (gate) · COM-002 structured data exceeds body · COM-003 unlabelled machine text Evidence levels describe how well supported a rule is, not how much it deducts — a heuristic rule is a hint, a strong rule is a measurable contradiction. REL-100 deducts 28 × (1 − words / 600) across all documents, rounded to one decimal, so a 300-word repository loses about half of the relevance weight and a 600-word-body repository loses nothing. De-duplication key is ruleId + normalized suggestion. A rule that fires in three files with the same advice is deducted once and the anchors are merged (up to six), so copying a bad paragraph into five pages cannot multiply the penalty. Findings are ordered error → warning → info, then by dimension, then by deduction. Bands: ≥ 85 excellent, ≥ 70 good, ≥ 50 fair, < 50 poor. A capped report keeps its band from the capped total. All four files come from one FactGraph, so they cannot disagree with each other. Page selection: root README first, then nested READMEs, then docs/, then other Markdown, capped by max-entries (default 20, PRD asks for 10–20). The generator warns when fewer than 10 pages are available rather than fabricating entries. Provenance: llms.txt and llms-full.txt start with an HTML comment naming the engine version, rule-pack version, timestamp and the files used. Summary: the package description when it is verifiable, otherwise the first meaningful paragraph. Facts lines (version, license, repository, homepage, last updated) are emitted only when the value exists. JSON-LD: @type is restricted to SoftwareApplication, TechArticle or FAQPage. Every field is checked against the concatenated visible text: name missing or absent from the text → blocking, the file is refused; description, softwareVersion, author absent → dropped, reported per field; aggregateRating and offers are never emitted, whatever the input contains. Write policy: default output directory is the system temp directory keyed by the repository hash. An existing file with different content is skipped and reported unless force. dry-run reports sizes and warnings without touching disk. ai.txt is byte-identical to llms.txt (alternate filename convention). International checks (AUD-INT-001…008): missing robots.txt, root-blocked AI crawlers (GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended, Applebot-Extended, Meta-ExternalAgent, CCBot, …), missing sitemap, empty sitemap, noindex, JS-only content (visible text below 5% of the HTML), missing canonical, duplicated canonical. Domestic checks (AUD-CN-001…005): blocked Chinese crawlers (Baiduspider, Bytespider, Sogou, 360Spider, YisouSpider), no Chinese page, thin Chinese page, missing viewport, blocked Baiduspider. Every audit prints three standing notes: robots permission is not citation, domestic index status cannot be verified from a repository, and the audit is offline. MONITOR_QUESTIONS holds 24 fixed questions covering definition, install, configuration, troubleshooting, comparison, pricing, privacy, limits, support, platform, trust, maintenance, requirements, CI, output, workflow, transparency and an expectation trap ("will you promise me a position?"). Questions use a {name} placeholder so the same bank applies to any plugin. A run records, per answer: question id, platform, mentioned, cited, optional note. Rates are mentions/samples and citations/samples, rounded to three decimals. MIN_SAMPLES = 20; below that the summary sets insufficientSample and every surface says the number is not statistically meaningful. The trend keeps the last ten runs. compareLastRun returns the delta against the previous run plus how many runs exist. Only facts are recorded — the tool never explains why a mention appeared. The report (schema version 1) contains: engine and rule-pack versions, timestamp, target, summary (total, band, capped, counts, documents, files, duration), dimensions with their findings, all findings, advisories, the fact summary, and parse errors. Paths are repository-relative with forward slashes, so a report is portable and diffable. State lives under DSH_GEO_SEO_HOME (default ~/.dsh/geo-seo): workspaces/ /history.jsonl and monitor.jsonl, plus last-target for the "use the previous directory" default. Append-only JSONL; a truncated line is skipped rather than breaking the history. src/index.ts exports apply(ctx, config), inject = ['webServer'] and a Config type. It registers five tools and one prefixed route (/geo-seo/api) with endpoints state, panel, questions, monitor (GET) and check, generate, audit, monitor (POST). Every registration goes through ctx.effect so a hot reload disposes the old route instead of leaking it. Unknown paths answer 404, wrong methods 405, and a bad target a 400 with the message. The panel is assets/panel.html, served by the host and rendered in an iframe inside the sidebar tab (client/index.js). It is a plain document: no bundler, no Harness client packages, no external assets. It reads /geo-seo/api/state on open and calls the same endpoints the CLI uses. Language follows the app locale when available, then the browser language, and can be switched in the panel; the choice is remembered in localStorage. New rule: add an entry to RULES in src/core/rules.ts with dimension, severity, deduction, evidence level, rationale and a check(ctx) returning findings; bump RULE_PACK_VERSION; add a fixture and an assertion in test/. New output format: implement it in src/core/render.ts and add the value to OutputFormat; the CLI and the panel both pick it up. New audit check: append to src/core/audit.ts with a AUD-INT- or AUD-CN- id and a scope; the notes array is shared. Lexical source inspection misses registration helpers that hide tool names behind variables. Freshness compares the declared date with git when git is available; a repository with no git history can only be checked for a stated date. The international/domestic split is a heuristic: it inspects static files in the repository, so content rendered by a server at request time is invisible to it. Scoring is rule-based and deterministic. Two repositories with the same visible facts score the same, which is the point — but it also means the score cannot judge whether the product is useful. Example: scanner (src/core/scan.ts) ├─ markdown.ts Markdown → headings, paragraphs, lists, code, tables, links, sections ├─ package-json.ts package.json → name, version, description, keywords, license, links ├─ source-ast.ts TS/JS → exports, registered tools/commands, config keys, inject list └─ site.ts robots.txt, sitemap.xml, llms.txt, ai.txt, HTML meta/JSON-LD/canonical ↓ FactGraph (facts + anchors + parse errors) rules (src/core/rules.ts) 34 rules + 3 advisories, each with deduction and evidence level ↓ findings, advisories, rule errors score (src/core/score.ts) de-duplication, per-dimension caps, gate, band ↓ ScoreResult generate (src/core/generate.ts) llms.txt, llms-full.txt, ai.txt, JSON-LD + verification audit (src/core/audit.ts) crawlability findings + standing notes monitor (src/core/monitor.ts) question bank, runs, rates, trend ↓ render (src/core/render.ts) text | json | markdown store (src/core/store.ts) history + monitor JSONL under ~/.dsh/geo-seo

## dsh-geo-seo — 实现细节 (docs/DETAIL.zh.md)

本页说明检查器内部如何工作：数据流、模块划分、评分算术、生成契约，以及那些「故意不做」 的地方。插件清单里的 meta.detail 指向本文件。 默认本地、离线。 内核里没有任何网络调用；CLI 与面板都不抓取外部内容，监测靠人工采样。 事实必须带锚点。 工具对仓库说的每句话，要么读自文件（带路径，通常带行号），要么由这些值算出。 指不到行号的规则不会上线。 规则包与引擎分离并带版本号。 每次输出、文件头注释和报告里都写入 RULE_PACK_VERSION， 同一个仓库同一版本可以复现同一个分数。 绝不编造事实。 生成器只能复述解析到的内容，JSON-LD 的逐字段校验用机制保证这一点。 不承诺结果。 输出里（包括面板与生成文件）不出现排名、流量、引用量的预测。 依赖是单向的：适配器依赖内核，内核不依赖适配器。src/core/index.ts 是唯一公开入口 （dsh-geo-seo/core）。 扫描上限：60 个 Markdown、200 个源码文件、深度 8、4000 个条目、单文件 4 MiB。忽略目录包括 .git、node_modules、dist、build、out、coverage、.next、.cache、.turbo、 vendor、.venv、pycache、.idea、.vscode、tmp、.geo-seo。源码扫描排除测试与 示例目录，避免夹具把分数抬高。 Markdown 用逐行扫描而非完整 CommonMark 实现：ATX/setext 标题、围栏与四空格代码块、带分隔行的 表格、带续行的列表、行内链接与裸 URL、YAML front matter。它对残缺输入刻意宽容：未闭合围栏、 畸形表格、CRLF 都不会抛错。 源码检查是词法级（正则），不是 TypeScript 程序，因此内核零依赖、速度快；代价是高度封装过的注册 代码可能识别不到，所以漏识别工具注册最多只扣机器可读维度的 4 分，而不是错误。 RULE_PACK = { name: 'geo-seo-core', version: '2026.02.1', released: '2026-02-18', scoringVersion: 1 }。每条规则声明维度、严重级别、扣分、实证级别（strong / moderate / weak / heuristic）和一句话理由。 维度 规则 相关性（28） REL-001 无 README · REL-002 无一级标题 · REL-003 首段没说清是什么 · REL-004 标题与正文实体不一致 · REL-005 关键词堆砌 · REL-100 文档过短（按缺口折减） 结构（22） STR-001 标题跳级 · STR-002 无章节结构 · STR-003 核心结论被埋 · STR-004 功能点是散文不是列表 · STR-005 多个一级标题 · STR-006 长页面无目录 事实密度（18） FAC-001 无安装命令 · FAC-002 未声明版本 · FAC-003 配置项未文档化 · FAC-004 无可运行示例 · FAC-005 无仓库/反馈链接 · FAC-006 数字无出处 新鲜度（10） FRE-001 无更新日期 · FRE-002 日期过旧（>365 天）· FRE-003 声明日期与提交历史不一致（>90 天）· FRE-004 无变更记录 机器可读（12） MAC-001 无 JSON-LD · MAC-002 JSON-LD 无效或缺少类型 · MAC-003 无 llms.txt · MAC-004 llms.txt 过薄 · MAC-005 robots 屏蔽 AI 爬虫 信任线索（7） TRU-001 无许可证 · TRU-002 无维护者 · TRU-003 无反馈渠道 · TRU-004 无发布历史 一致性与合规（3） COM-001 不可证实的承诺（否决项）· COM-002 结构化数据超出正文 · COM-003 机器生成内容未标注 实证级别描述的是「这条规则有多少依据」，不是「扣多少分」：heuristic 是提示， strong 是可度量的矛盾。 REL-100 的扣分为 28 × (1 − 全部文档字数 / 600)，保留一位小数：300 字丢掉约一半相关性权重， 600 字以上不扣。 去重键是 ruleId + 归一化建议。同一条建议在三个文件命中只扣一次，锚点合并（最多 6 个）， 所以把一段坏文案复制到五页不会成倍扣分。 发现按 错误 → 警告 → 提示 排序，再按维度、再按扣分。 分档：≥85 excellent，≥70 good，≥50 fair，其余 poor；被否决项压分的报告按压分后的总分取档。 四个文件都来自同一个 FactGraph，因此彼此不可能互相矛盾。 页面选择：根 README 优先，其次子目录 README，再其次 docs/，最后其它 Markdown， 由 max-entries 控制（默认 20，PRD 要求 10–20）。不足 10 条时给警告，而不是编造条目。 来源注释：llms.txt 与 llms-full.txt 开头有 HTML 注释，写明引擎版本、规则包版本、 生成时间和使用的文件。 摘要：能用 package 描述就用描述，否则取第一个有意义的段落；版本、许可证、仓库、主页、 最后更新这些事实行只在值存在时输出。 JSON-LD：@type 只允许 SoftwareApplication、TechArticle、FAQPage。每个字段都与 可见正文拼接文本核对：name 缺失或正文中找不到 → 阻断，拒绝写入；description、 softwareVersion、author 找不到 → 丢弃并逐项报告；aggregateRating、offers 无论输入如何都不输出。 写入策略：默认输出到系统临时目录（按仓库哈希分目录）。目标文件已存在且内容不同，在没有 force 时跳过并报告，绝不静默覆盖。 dry-run 只报告大小与警告。 ai.txt 与 llms.txt 内容逐字节相同（另一命名约定）。 国际（AUD-INT-001…008）：缺 robots.txt、根路径屏蔽主流 AI 爬虫（GPTBot、OAI-SearchBot、 ChatGPT-User、ClaudeBot、PerplexityBot、Google-Extended、Applebot-Extended、 Meta-ExternalAgent、CCBot 等）、缺 sitemap、sitemap 为空、noindex、内容依赖 JS（可见正文 低于 HTML 的 5%）、缺 canonical、canonical 复用。 国内（AUD-CN-001…005）：屏蔽国内爬虫（Baiduspider、Bytespider、Sogou、360Spider、 YisouSpider）、无中文页面、中文页面过短、缺 viewport、屏蔽 Baiduspider。 每次审计都打印三条固定提示：robots 放行不等于会被引用；国内收录状态无法从仓库验证；审计全程离线。 MONITOR_QUESTIONS 共 24 条固定问题，覆盖定义、安装、配置、排错、对比、价格、隐私、限制、 支持、平台、信任、维护、环境要求、CI、输出、工作流、透明度，以及一个「期望陷阱」 （「你会承诺排名吗？」）。问题文本用 {name} 占位，同一套问题适用于任何插件。 每次复测对每个回答记录：问题 id、平台、是否提及、是否引用本站、可选备注。比率 = 提及数/样本数、 引用数/样本数，保留三位小数。MIN_SAMPLES = 20，样本不足时汇总标记 insufficientSample，所有界面都注明「不具统计意义」。趋势保留最近 10 次。 compareLastRun 返回与上一次的差值以及已有次数。工具只记录事实，不解释「为什么被提及」。 报告（schema 版本 1）包含：引擎与规则包版本、生成时间、目标、汇总（总分、分档、是否压分、 各级计数、文档数、文件数、耗时）、带发现项的维度、全部发现项、提示项、事实摘要、解析错误。 路径统一为仓库相对路径与正斜杠，因此报告可移植、可 diff。 状态目录由 DSH_GEO_SEO_HOME 指定（默认 ~/.dsh/geo-seo）： workspaces/ /history.jsonl、monitor.jsonl，以及记录上次目标的 last-target。追加式 JSONL，坏行跳过而不破坏历史。 src/index.ts 导出 apply(ctx, config)、inject = ['webServer'] 与 Config 类型， 注册五个工具和一条前缀路由 /geo-seo/api：GET state / panel / questions / monitor，POST check / generate / audit / monitor。所有注册都包在 ctx.effect 里， 热重载时释放旧路由而不是泄漏。未知路径返回 404，方法不匹配返回 405，目标非法返回 400 并带消息。 面板是 assets/panel.html，由宿主路由提供，在侧栏标签页的 iframe 里渲染 （client/index.js）。它是一份普通文档：不需要打包器、不依赖 Harness 客户端包、无外部资源。 打开时读取 /geo-seo/api/state，调用与 CLI 相同的端点。语言优先跟随应用 locale，其次浏览器 语言，可在面板内切换，选择记在 localStorage。 新增规则：在 src/core/rules.ts 的 RULES 里加一条（维度、级别、扣分、实证级别、 理由、返回发现项的 check(ctx)），提升 RULE_PACK_VERSION，并在 test/ 里加夹具与断言。 新增输出格式：在 src/core/render.ts 实现，并把值加入 OutputFormat；CLI 与面板自动支持。 新增审计检查：在 src/core/audit.ts 追加，使用 AUD-INT- 或 AUD-CN- 编号并声明 scope； 固定提示数组共用。 词法级源码检查无法识别把工具名藏在变量后面的注册写法。 新鲜度在有 git 时与提交历史对比；没有 git 历史的仓库只能检查是否声明了日期。 国际/国内的分组是启发式的：只读仓库里的静态文件，服务端运行时渲染的内容看不到。 评分是规则化、确定性的。可见事实相同的两个仓库得分相同——这是刻意设计，但也意味着分数无法 判断产品是否好用。 Example: 扫描层 scan.ts ├─ markdown.ts 标题、段落、列表、代码块、表格、链接、章节 ├─ package-json.ts 名称、版本、描述、关键词、许可证、仓库与主页 ├─ source-ast.ts 导出项、注册的工具/命令、配置项、inject └─ site.ts robots.txt / sitemap.xml / llms.txt / ai.txt / HTML 元信息与 JSON-LD ↓ FactGraph（事实 + 锚点 + 解析错误） 规则层 rules.ts 34 条规则 + 3 条提示，每条带扣分与实证级别 ↓ findings / advisories / ruleErrors 评分层 score.ts 去重、维度封顶、否决项、分档 ↓ ScoreResult 生成层 generate.ts llms.txt / llms-full.txt / ai.txt / JSON-LD + 一致性校验 审计层 audit.ts 可抓取性发现 + 固定提示 监测层 monitor.ts 问题库、复测记录、比率、趋势 ↓ 呈现层 render.ts text | json | markdown 存储层 store.ts ~/.dsh/geo-seo 下的历史与监测 JSONL

## dsh-geo-seo · 项目简介 (docs/INTRO.md)

「招牌」文案库：四种长度、中英各一套，可直接取用到 GitHub About、package.json、插件市场卡片、README 开头与 llms.txt 摘要。每一版都按本项目的规则写——结论前置、实体同名、事实可核验、明确边界、不承诺排名。 给 AI 引擎看的 SEO：读出仓库里的真实事实，按七维 100 分制打分，扣分精确到行。 dsh-geo-seo 是一个 DSH 插件与 CLI。它读取真实仓库——README、package.json、源码、robots.txt、sitemap——用 34 条规则在七个维度上给出 100 分制评分，扣分定位到 file:line，并能从同一份事实图一次生成 llms.txt、llms-full.txt、ai.txt 与 JSON-LD。全程离线，结果可复现，不承诺排名。 dsh-geo-seo 是一个 DSH 插件兼 CLI，用来测量项目文档在 AI 引擎里能不能被读懂、能不能被引用，并指出该改哪几行。 它不猜排名。它读你的仓库——README、package.json、源码、robots.txt、sitemap、HTML——建成一张带 file:line 锚点的事实图，再按七维加权规则打分（主题相关性 28、关键信息结构 22、事实密度 18、时间新鲜度 10、机器可读 12、信任线索 7、合规 3，合计 100）。扣分项指向行号，每条建议标注实证权重：strong / moderate / weak / heuristic。 四件事，一条链路： 解析：README 结构、包元数据、源码里导出的函数与注册的工具，每个事实带来源锚点 评分：34 条规则跑在事实图上；严重合规问题把总分封顶 60，文档过短按缺口比例折减 生成：llms.txt、llms-full.txt、ai.txt、JSON-LD，只写正文能核对的字段，校验不过就拒写 监测：24 条问题库逐次复测，样本不足 20 条时只记事实、不给结论 安装并跑第一次检查： 当前版本 0.1.0，要求 Node 22.6 与 DSH 0.30 及以上；MIT 许可；维护者 garcey。默认完全离线：不联网、不上传、不调用第三方接口。 边界写在明面上：不预测排名、流量或引用；robots 放行不等于国内引擎可引用；监测样本不足时不给结论。 问题：AI 引擎读你的项目，和人类读你的项目，不是同一件事。它不看导航、不点展开、不执行 JS，只抓它认得的文本与结构；被截断、被误判、被当成营销话术的部分，直接不进入回答。 做法：dsh-geo-seo 不做关键词堆砌，也不做「排名提升」的承诺。它把仓库解析成事实图——文档结构、包元数据、源码里的导出与工具、robots 与 sitemap、页面可见正文——每个事实都带来源锚点（文件、行号、节点路径）。规则层在这张图上跑，产出可复核的扣分明细；生成层用同一份事实渲染机器可读资产；呈现层只负责展示，不参与判断。 结果：一个 0–100 的总分、七个维度的分解、按严重度排序的扣分清单（附改写建议与证据级别），以及四个可直接发布的文件：llms.txt、llms-full.txt、ai.txt、structured-data.jsonld。 为什么不吹效果：排名、流量、引用三者都无法归因到单一页面改动，任何「提升 X%」的承诺都不可证伪。这个工具只做一件事——把「引擎能否读懂、能否核验」变成可测量、可回归的数字。 dsh-geo-seo 是一个 DSH 插件与 CLI，读取仓库事实并按七维 100 分制评估 GEO 就绪度，扣分定位到 file:line，可一次生成 llms.txt、llms-full.txt、ai.txt 与 JSON-LD；离线运行，不承诺排名。 SEO for engines that read: measure what a repository actually says, score it across seven weighted dimensions, and fix the exact lines that block citation. dsh-geo-seo is a DSH plugin and CLI. It reads the real repository — README, package.json, sources, robots.txt, sitemap — scores documentation against 34 rules across seven weighted dimensions out of 100, points every deduction at a file and line, and renders llms.txt, llms-full.txt, ai.txt and JSON-LD from the same fact graph. Offline, deterministic, and it never promises a ranking. dsh-geo-seo is a DSH plugin and CLI that measures whether AI engines can read and cite your project documentation, and points at the lines to fix. It does not predict rankings. It reads the repository — README, package.json, sources, robots.txt, sitemap, HTML — builds a fact graph with file:line anchors, then scores it against weighted rules across seven dimensions (topic relevance 28, structure 22, fact density 18, freshness 10, machine-readable 12, trust 7, compliance 3, for 100 points total). Deductions point at lines; every suggestion states its evidence strength: strong, moderate, weak or heuristic. Four steps, one pipeline: Parse: README structure, package metadata, exported functions and registered tools, each fact carrying a source anchor Score: 34 rules over the graph; a compliance gate caps the total at 60, short documents reduce relevance proportionally Generate: llms.txt, llms-full.txt, ai.txt and JSON-LD with verifiable fields only; it refuses to write when the consistency check fails Monitor: a 24-question bank re-run over time, reported as facts until 20 samples exist Install and run the first check: Current version 0.1.0; requires Node 22.6+ and DSH 0.30+; MIT licensed; maintained by garcey. Offline by default: no network calls, no uploads, no third-party APIs. The limits are part of the product: no ranking, traffic or citation forecasts; an open robots.txt does not mean a Chinese engine will cite you; monitoring data under 20 samples is reported as facts without a verdict. The problem. An AI engine reading your project is not the same reader as a human. It does not use navigation, expand accordions or run JavaScript; it takes the text and structure it can parse. Whatever is truncated, misclassified or reads like marketing simply does not make it into the answer. The approach. dsh-geo-seo does not stuff keywords and does not sell ranking promises. It parses the repository into a fact graph — document structure, package metadata, exported functions and registered tools, robots and sitemap, visible page text — with a source anchor for every fact (file, line, node path). The rule layer evaluates that graph and produces auditable deductions; the generate layer renders machine-readable assets from the same facts; the presentation layer only displays, never decides. The output. A 0–100 score, seven dimension sub-scores, a severity-ordered list of deductions with rewrite suggestions and evidence levels, and four publishable files: llms.txt, llms-full.txt, ai.txt, structured-data.jsonld. Why no effect claims. Ranking, traffic and citations cannot be attributed to a single page edit; any "X% uplift" claim is unfalsifiable. This tool does one thing instead — turns "can an engine read and verify this?" into a number that can be measured and regression-tested. dsh-geo-seo is a DSH plugin and CLI that scores repository documentation for AI-engine readability across seven weighted dimensions out of 100, points deductions at file:line, and renders llms.txt, llms-full.txt, ai.txt and JSON-LD. Offline; no ranking promises. 位置 用哪一版 备注 package.json 的 description 卡片版首句（约 160 字符） npm / 插件列表会截断，第二句留给详情页 GitHub About 一句话 + 关键词 关键词用 geo、seo、llms.txt、dsh-plugin 插件市场卡片 卡片版 与 locale/*.json 的 meta.description 保持一致 README 首段 标准版 首段决定「是否回答了它是什么」这一维度 发布页 / 详情页 长版 四个小标题本身就是可被抓取的结构 本仓库生成的 llms.txt 摘要行 与 README 首段同义，避免实体漂移 一致性要求：六处文案对同一实体的称呼必须一致——插件叫 dsh-geo-seo，CLI 二进制叫 geo-seo，不要混写成「GEO SEO 工具」「SEO 插件」。 Example: pnpm add -D dsh-geo-seo geo-seo check --dir . --format text

## Changelog (CHANGELOG.md)

All notable changes to dsh-geo-seo are recorded here, one dated section per release. The rule pack has its own version (see src/core/rules.ts, RULE_PACK_VERSION) because a rule change alters scores without altering behaviour. First release, rule pack 2026.02.1. Parser: Markdown structure, package.json, and TS/JS source exports, tools, commands and config keys, each fact carrying a file:line anchor. A file that fails to parse is recorded in parseErrors and does not abort the scan. Scoring: 100 points across seven fixed dimensions, a compliance gate that caps the total at 60, proportional relevance loss for short documents, and cross-file deduplication of repeated suggestions. Generation: llms.txt, llms-full.txt, ai.txt and structured-data.jsonld from a single parse, with field-by-field JSON-LD verification against the visible text and a refusal to overwrite a differing file without force. Audit: international and domestic reachability checks with three standing notes, including that an open robots.txt does not imply citation. Monitor: a 24-question bank, recorded samples, mention and citation rates, and trend reporting that flags samples under 20 as not statistically meaningful. Interfaces: CLI with stable exit codes for CI, a DSH plugin exposing five agent tools, a /geo-seo/api route, and a sidebar panel.
